LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DeathField.label: <color=#E85A7A>Deathflow Field</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DeathField.description: Create a circular <color=#C9A2FF>field</color> 18 cells in diameter. Units inside the field other than <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color> suffer <color=#B86CFF>20% slow</color>; every second they gain a <color=#E85A7A>bleeding</color> wound and 1 Death Sentence accumulation. Death Sentence decays rapidly after leaving the field. At 9 accumulation, the last applier executes the target.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Guiyi.label: <color=#C77DFF>Uncanny Remedy</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Guiyi.description: Costs <color=#E85A7A>1 Karma</color>. Heals all diseases and injuries on the target. This restores missing limbs and removes addictions, mechanical damage, permanent old wounds, and other negative health conditions. <color=#C77DFF>Uncanny Remedy</color> cannot target Zhaoli herself or hostile targets, and creates a <color=#D66BFF>Karma Link</color> on the target for 30 days.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Dingshu.label: <color=#C9A2FF>Fixed Fate</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Dingshu.description: Costs <color=#E85A7A>2 Karma</color>. Zhaoli channels black karma into a corpse for <color=#C9A2FF>50 minutes</color>, resurrecting it whole and healing all injuries without resurrection sickness. The resurrected target forms a Karma Link with Zhaoli and gains a <color=#C9A2FF>Fixed Fate Mark</color> for <color=#C77DFF>12 days</color>. If the target dies again while marked, it cannot be resurrected again. This skill has no effect while Zhaoli is in raid state.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minghuo.label: <color=#FF6A6A>Netherflame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minghuo.description: Costs <color=#E85A7A>3 Karma</color>. Binds dead karma to Zhaoli's current primary weapon for 1 day. While enchanted, weapon damage, armor penetration, accuracy, and attack speed are increased to <color=#FF6A6A>1.5x</color>, range is increased by 2 cells, and each melee hit adds a burst of <color=#FF8A66>flame damage</color>.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minshen.label: <color=#C77DFF>Mind-Effacement</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minshen.description: Costs <color=#E85A7A>3 Karma</color>. Suppresses hostile units in a <color=#B86CFF>13x13</color> area around the target point. Flesh targets suffer Life-Erosion for 5 seconds, taking 1 armor-ignoring blunt damage to the torso each second. 90% are also slowed by <color=#C77DFF>80%</color>, while 10% are rendered <color=#D66BFF>mindless for 30 seconds</color>. Mechanoids ignore the mindless and slow effects and instead take a direct <color=#E85A7A>EMP</color> pulse.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Duanzhan.label: <color=#E85A7A>Severing Slash</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Duanzhan.description: After briefly lowering the blade, Zhaoli releases a <color=#E85A7A>severing arc</color> that sweeps through enemies ahead in violet-white light. Targets on the central line take heavier cutting damage. If <color=#FF6A6A>Netherflame</color> is still bound to the weapon, a small amount of flame damage is added.
